text:
Maria P.: Nightly e2e gate flagged red for mixedseq throughput at ~02:13 UTC. p50 ok, but throughput falls ~30% during concurrency ramp. CI dashboard: https://ci.redwood/inference/2468
ci-bot: nightly-e2e-run #2468 failed: throughput < threshold (mixedseq). Logs attached.
Devin L.: ugh. any stack traces or flaky test names? which stage?
Maria P.: failing stage: mixer-concurrency-ramp (step 4). sample log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T02:12:45Z] worker-7: request queue latency spiked from 12ms -> 180ms
[2026-03-16T02:12:46Z] kvcache: miss-rate 0.72 -> 0.93
[2026-03-16T02:12:46Z] scheduler: throttling new requests
```
Raj S.: kvcache miss-rate jump looks suspect. any recent kvcache change in last 10 commits?
Maria P.: last deploy bumped async-evict param in runtime: https://git.redwood/infra/commit/ab12cd. That was yesterday 23:50 UTC.
Jen K.: I saw a similar p95 blip on canary earlier today, maybe related. cc @Devin L.
Devin L.: ok let's try a targeted rerun first. Maria can you rerun the nightly job with `KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1` and `NO_PREFETCH=1`? also disable batching heuristics: `BATCHING_ENABLED=false`
Maria P.: on it. kicking off rerun: `./ci rerun 2468 --env KV_CACHE_DEBUG=1,NO_PREFETCH=1,BATCHING_ENABLED=false`
ci-bot: rerun started: nightly-e2e-run #2468.1 (triggered by Maria P.)
Raj S.: if rerun reproduces, I can bisect commits  ab12cd..HEAD for kvcache and scheduler. offer to run bisect if needed.
Maria P.: rerun in progress — ETA ~12m. I'll post results.
Jen K.: if rerun passes, we should still run smoke-canary with same flags before rolling back change.
Devin L.: agree. if rerun fails, tag me and Raj, will start binary search. also log collection: `ci download-logs 2468.1 --path /tmp/e2e-2468-logs`
Maria P.: rerun finished — still failing. throughput down ~28% same pattern. attaching perf heatmap: https://artifacts.redwood/2468/heatmap.png
Devin L.: thanks. Raj pls start bisect on infra repo, narrow to kvcache changes first.
Raj S.: starting `git bisect start HEAD ab12cd -- infra/runtime -- script/bisect-e2e --pattern mixedseq` will update when I have a candidate.
oncall-bot: oncall reminder: paging SRE for high-impact nightly perf failures.
Maria P.: thx. I've marked rollout pause on the infra change and notified release leads. Will await bisect result.
Raj S.: bisect found candidate commit ab34ef that tweaks kvcache eviction thresholds. scheduling an isolated test on a small cluster now.
Jen K.: appreciate the quick coordination :thumbsup:
Devin L.: ping once isolated test completes, we may revert or adjust thresholds. I'll open a rollback PR if we confirm.
Maria P.: noted. closing loop when actioned. thanks all.
